source.selection_rule: next32 complete articles with >=3072 tokens after all96 prior row intervals, in pinned shard source order; exclude duplicate document and prompt-prefix hashes
source.pre_run_length_rationale: 3072 prompt +1024 output retains active requests longer while later long prefills are admitted; 3968+128 could drain before 32 requests become active. This is regime qualification, chosen before GPU results.
source.reconstruction_rule: concatenate original row strings exactly from one top-level title to before the next; no added separators
source.identity_scope: Document, row and prompt-prefix disjoint from original32 and holdout cohort0/1 (96 prior requests); same dataset, lengths and steady-arrival regime, not an independent population.

input_preparation: offline fresh32 prefix inputs; GPU UNRUN; inherited SLO fields are reference only
metric_role: continuous request metrics primary; SLO 5s/.2s reference only
